items.title: Added Nano+Bluetooth (HC-05/HC-06 SPP) setup guide and a bt_serial_probe utility to help identify the Windows Bluetooth COM port and validate connectivity.
Manual control: pauses tracking/aiming during manual nudges and auto-resumes after the suppression window for smoother manual pan/tilt across modes.
YOLO Settings: added max area filter control with persistence and post-processing filtering.
AutoTrack Lab: added OpenCV tracker fallback to avoid 'cv2 has no attribute' errors by using detection-only tracking when contrib trackers are unavailable.
AutoTrack Lab: simplified detection with default blob detector for reliable precision tracking (YOLO optional).
AutoTrack Lab: synced pan/tilt limits to main app defaults (PAN 0–220, TILT 0–70).
AutoTrack Lab: added camera selection control with live reopen and saved camera index.
AutoTrack Lab UI: auto-run on launch, single Connect/Disconnect toggle, dark theme styling, and camera debug logging with backend/index fallbacks.

AutoTrack Lab: added isolated experimental app in autotrack_lab with First-Lock targeting, Follow/Quick Strike modes, YOLO+tracker hybrid pipeline, and Dual Port defaults (COM8 Nano IO + COM9 Debug Board pan/tilt).

TRIGGER FIX: Fixed projectile servo not firing in Dual Port mode. Root cause: Arduino single-token parser incorrectly matched packed commands (F1L1R0G0S0M1) as 'F1', ignoring mode token M1. Fix: Python now sends S0/M1 as separate commands before F/L/R/G, ensuring Arduino correctly sets projectile mode before processing fire. Arduino sketch also updated to check line length before treating as single-token.

Current telemetry + Health Monitor: stop graph flatlining at 0 when telemetry is missing; add explicit 'No telemetry' status and COM-swap warning; added Dual Port Nano IO+telemetry 2026 firmware (STAT I=<mA> on A2); SerialBus Upgrade 2026 firmware now enables total-current telemetry by default (A2).
